text: Security underpins agentic adoption by enabling seamless onboarding of E7 bundle users—89% of which rely on zero-trust frameworks. Without end-to-end encryption and identity validation, enterprise agents risk data exfiltration, undermining trust in AI-driven workflows. For example, Salesforce’s E7 bundle mandates OAuth 2.0 and device posture checks, reducing breach incidents by 40% in Q1 2024.
